ranked_plan.claim: install.ps1 forwards the profile as two argv words (-presentation-profile $PresentationProfile); with the default empty value Windows PowerShell 5.1 drops the empty argument, configserver.exe gets a trailing flag with no value, flag.Parse exits 2 and every default from-source Windows install fails.
ranked_plan.fix: Forward the profile as one token, "-presentation-profile=$PresentationProfile", so an empty value survives Windows PowerShell 5.1's empty-argument dropping.

ranked_plan.claim: ruleDelta reads the working side of changed declaration files from disk while acdsl check loads rules only from FileUniverse; `git rm --cached acdsl/rules.acdsl` plus a .git/info/exclude entry disables every central rule while CheckPolicy reports zero removed rules in a gated/strict repo.
ranked_plan.fix: In ruleDelta, take the working side only for paths in FileUniverse(ctx, root) — a changed path absent from the universe counts as deleted so its base rules land in delta.removed; keep the refuter's TestRefuteMaj9 scenario as a policy_test.go case.

ranked_plan.claim: GitChangedFiles tokenizes git diff --name-only / ls-files --others output with strings.Fields and without -z, so a declaration file whose path has a space or non-ASCII byte never reaches ruleDelta under its real name and contributes no rules on either side; gated/strict branches can change protected rules in such a file unreported.
ranked_plan.fix: Use `git diff --name-only -z <base>` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z`, split on NUL instead of strings.Fields, so paths reach ruleDelta verbatim.

ranked_plan.claim: policyBase recognizes the base branch only by stripping a literal "origin/" prefix, so with base_ref "upstream/main" or "refs/heads/main" a human on the base branch itself is treated as a boundary and uncommitted surface changes on main are flagged, contradicting correctness-71.
ranked_plan.fix: Treat HEAD == rev-parse(<candidate>) as the vacuous case alongside the branch-name match, or derive baseName from git rev-parse --symbolic-full-name <candidate> with refs/heads/ or refs/remotes/<remote>/ stripped.
